description.la: De scripturis et scriptoribus sacris; adnotationes in Pentateuchon, Judices, Ruth, Reges, Threnos; expositio in Abdiam et in Joelem.
description.en-US: Hugh’s exegetical notes: the introduction On Scripture and the Sacred Writers, the Pentateuch, Judges, Ruth, Kings, Lamentations, Obadiah and (of doubtful authorship in PL) Joel. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 175, 1854), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: As notas exegéticas de Hugo: a introdução sobre a Escritura e os escritores sagrados, o Pentateuco, Juízes, Rute, Reis, Lamentações, Abdias e Joel.
